summary: Iteration 2 e2e testing complete. All 18 pytest backend tests pass (pickup COD checkout, delivery COD starts pending, seller-advance flow, assign-rider only for delivery, pickup advance path confirmed->ready_for_pickup->picked_up, buyer/seller cancel with stock restore, stranger buyer cannot cancel, delivered cannot be cancelled, online Stripe checkout regression, riders have lat/lng). Frontend Playwright verified: checkout fulfillment toggle (delivery vs pickup), MapPicker mounts + Leaflet OSM tiles load (6 tiles) + pin-coords updates on map click, pickup switch hides map+address, pickup+COD order placement, seller dashboard shows Mark Confirmed advance button + Cancel + rider dropdown ONLY for delivery (0 pickup orders showed rider select), seller cancel restores stock with toast. Fixed a real runtime crash in MapPicker/DeliveryMap ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading _leaflet_pos)') caused by unclaimed setTimeout(invalidateSize, 250) firing after the map is unmounted (e.g., when Checkout auto-redirects on empty cart).

minor.issue: Cancelling an order does not decrement seller_stats.revenue in the same request; revenue is recomputed on next GET /api/seller/stats which correctly excludes status=='cancelled'. Acceptable but note that cod_pending revenue is counted before delivery — reconsider whether cancelled COD orders were ever counted (they are excluded by status check, so OK).
allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; still works via ingress same-origin but flag for prod.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent — unclaimed setTimeout(map.invalidateSize, 250) fired after map.remove() when the component unmounted quickly (e.g., Checkout auto-redirects to /market when cart is empty or /login when unauthenticated). Produced two 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading _leaflet_pos)' pageerrors shown by the react-error-overlay. Fix: clear the timer and cancelAnimationFrame in cleanup, wrapped invalidateSize in try/catch.

useEffect runs `if (!user) navigate('/login')` immediately on mount without waiting for AuthContext.loading. On a hard-refresh or page.goto('/checkout'), user is null on the first tick before /api/auth/me resolves, so authenticated users are incorrectly bounced to /login. Same pattern in SellerDashboard.jsx BUT it guards with `if (loading) return;` — Checkout should follow the same pattern.

action_items: Checkout.jsx should also gate the redirect on `!loading && !user` (mirror SellerDashboard.jsx pattern) so refreshing /checkout does not bounce authenticated users to /login. Cart.jsx checkout link masks this in normal flow, but /checkout is a valid direct route.
Consider making the MapPicker/DeliveryMap fix in-code (testing agent already applied it) — kept the invalidateSize try/catch + clearTimeout safety net.
critical_code_review_comments: MapPicker/DeliveryMap useEffect had a setTimeout for map.invalidateSize() but no clearTimeout on unmount. Any React strict-mode double-effect or route change during mount would crash Leaflet internals. Fixed.

server.py: single file (~501 lines) still fine for MVP but auth/products/orders/payments should be split into routers before further growth. Iteration 2 added ~50 lines (cancel endpoint + fulfillment fields).
server.py cancel_order permission check uses `uid in o.get('seller_ids', [])` — correct for multi-seller carts.
restore_stock() correctly guards with `stock_restored` flag so double-cancel or stripe-expired-then-cancel won't double-refund stock.

Frontend uses Leaflet via CDN in public/index.html (window.L). If the CDN is unreachable, DeliveryMap/MapPicker silently early-return (`if (!window.L) return`) — leaves an empty div. Consider a fallback message.
Checkout.jsx pickup path uses `items[0]?.location` as pickupLocation — for multi-seller carts this only shows the first item's farm. Acceptable for MVP since typically single farm per order.

rca of the issue: MapPicker/DeliveryMap crash RCA: In their useEffect, after map init they queue `setTimeout(() => map.invalidateSize(), 250)` to fix Leaflet sizing after DOM paint. Cleanup only called `map.remove()`. When the checkout page rendered MapPicker but immediately redirected (empty cart → /market), the timer fired ~250ms later against a torn-down Leaflet map whose internal _mapPane was undefined, throwing 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading _leaflet_pos)'. Fix: capture the timer id in the useEffect and clear it in cleanup, plus wrap invalidateSize in try/catch.
